## Steps and Citations

**Step 1: Confirm the 2022 FIFA Men's World Cup was held**

The 2022 FIFA World Cup was held in Qatar from 20 November to 18 December 2022. Argentina won the tournament, defeating France in the final.

> [1] Wikipedia – "2022 FIFA World Cup"
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup

---

**Step 2: Obtain the list of players named to national team squads for the 2022 World Cup**

All 32 national teams submitted squads of 26 players each. Key squads referenced for identifying award winners:

> [2] Wikipedia – "2022 FIFA World Cup squads"
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup_squads

This confirms the following players named to squads:
- **Lionel Messi** – Argentina squad
- **Cristiano Ronaldo** – Portugal squad
- **Luka Modrić** – Croatia squad
- **Karim Benzema** – Named to France squad (then withdrew injured before the tournament; however, he was officially named/called up). *Note: Benzema was initially named to the France squad but withdrew due to injury before the tournament began. His selection/naming to the squad still counts as being "named to a national team squad."*
- **Kylian Mbappé** – France squad

> [3] Wikipedia – "Ballon d'Or"
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballon_d%27Or

> [4] Wikipedia – "UEFA Men's Player of the Year Award"
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Men%27s_Player_of_the_Year_Award

From these sources:

- **Lionel Messi**: Ballon d'Or winner 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2015, 2019, 2021, 2023; UEFA Best Player in Europe 2009, 2010, 2011, 2015, 2019 ✓

- **Luka Modrić**: Ballon d'Or winner 2018; UEFA Men's Player of the Year 2017/18 ✓
- **Karim Benzema**: Ballon d'Or winner 2022; UEFA Men's Player of the Year 2021/22 ✓
- **Kylian Mbappé**: Ballon d'Or winner 2024 ✓
